section_summary: This section chiefly records Japanese merchant-vessel movements reported by U.S. posts in Asia, Australia, and the Americas in January 1941, with State Department paraphrases sent to the Navy. A Managua despatch lists earlier calls at Corinto, while a Sydney despatch explains obstacles to reporting Australian itineraries. Several August 1941 reports and one July 1941 letter are interfiled with the January material.

people.name: Frank M. June
people.role: Naval attaché and naval attaché for air

people.name: Wilson
people.role: Sender of Montevideo report; named on a Buenos Aires paraphrase

people.name: Lieutenant Van Blarcom
people.role: Requested inquiry about Japanese ships in Netherlands East Indies ports

subfiles.title: Venice Maru at Callao
subfiles.about: Reports the Venice Maru’s arrival at Callao and planned northbound calls.
subfiles.summary: The 4,000-ton ship arrived from Cerro Azul and was due to sail for Chancay, Huacho, Paita, Manzanillo, and Los Angeles.

subfiles.title: Venice Maru report for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Passes the Lima report on the Venice Maru to the Navy.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases its arrival and projected northbound itinerary.

subfiles.title: Yamayato Maru at Curaçao
subfiles.about: Reports the Yamayato Maru’s arrival and departure from Curaçao.
subfiles.summary: The vessel arrived from New York and departed for Buenos Aires via Rio de Janeiro and Montevideo.

subfiles.title: Yamayato Maru report for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Relays the Curaçao report on the Yamayato Maru.
subfiles.summary: Records its arrival from New York and route toward Buenos Aires.

subfiles.title: Yamayato Maru Navy teleprinter copy
subfiles.about: Provides another paraphrase of the Curaçao report.
subfiles.summary: Repeats the vessel’s arrival and onward South American ports.

subfiles.title: Hamburg Maru at Singapore
subfiles.about: Reports the Hamburg Maru’s Singapore call.
subfiles.summary: The ship arrived from Saigon on January 5 and sailed for Belawan on January 9; later calls were unknown.

subfiles.title: Hamburg Maru report for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Relays the Hamburg Maru’s Singapore movements.
subfiles.summary: Repeats the arrival from Saigon and departure for Belawan.

subfiles.title: Sagami Maru at Puntarenas
subfiles.about: Reports the Sagami Maru’s arrival and intended route.
subfiles.summary: The ship arrived from Manzanillo and was scheduled for Balboa, Buenaventura, and Callao.

subfiles.title: Sagami Maru report for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Relays the Puntarenas report on the Sagami Maru.
subfiles.summary: Repeats its arrival and projected ports.

subfiles.title: Hie Maru and Norway Maru at Antofagasta
subfiles.about: Reports two Japanese vessels’ calls at Antofagasta.
subfiles.summary: Both vessels departed toward Japan by way of San Pedro, California.

subfiles.title: Hawaii Maru and Matumoto Maru at Singapore
subfiles.about: Reports two Singapore vessel calls, with part of the message garbled.
subfiles.summary: Records the Hawaii Maru’s arrival from Miri and the Matumoto Maru’s route from Hong Kong toward Colombo.

subfiles.title: Singapore vessel report for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Relays the initial Singapore report while flagging a garbled destination.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases movements of the Hawaii Maru and Matumoto Maru.

subfiles.title: Corrected Singapore vessel telegram
subfiles.about: Supplies the corrected destination for the Hawaii Maru.
subfiles.summary: The Hawaii Maru sailed for Colombo and South Africa; the Matumoto Maru sailed for Colombo via Penang and Rangoon.

subfiles.title: Corrected Singapore report for Navy
subfiles.about: Relays the corrected Singapore vessel movements.
subfiles.summary: Identifies South Africa as the Hawaii Maru’s onward destination.

subfiles.title: Illegible liaison sheet
subfiles.about: Contains largely illegible liaison-office text.
subfiles.summary: No reliable substantive content is readable.

subfiles.title: Information regarding calling of Japanese vessels
subfiles.about: Explains how the legation obtained confidential reports on Japanese calls at Corinto.
subfiles.summary: With no American consular officers at Nicaraguan ports, Nicholson arranged for a steamship agent to provide information. Four earlier sailings were passed to the naval attaché, and a copy of Nicholson’s letter was enclosed.

subfiles.title: Four Japanese vessel calls at Corinto
subfiles.about: Lists recent Corinto calls by four Japanese ships.
subfiles.summary: Gives dates, routes, tonnage, cargo, and agents for the Rakuyo Maru, Noto Maru, Venice Maru, and Norway Maru.

subfiles.title: Copy of Managua despatch on Japanese vessels
subfiles.about: Duplicates the despatch explaining collection of Corinto shipping information.
subfiles.summary: Describes the steamship-agent arrangement and enclosed naval attaché letter.

subfiles.title: Copy of Corinto vessel letter
subfiles.about: Duplicates the letter listing four Japanese ships’ Corinto calls.
subfiles.summary: The copy is OCR damaged, especially in its final vessel entry.

subfiles.title: Yamaura Maru at Curaçao
subfiles.about: Reports the Yamaura Maru’s call and route toward Los Angeles.
subfiles.summary: It arrived from Santos and left via Cristóbal.

subfiles.title: Yamaura Maru report for Navy and Coast Guard
subfiles.about: Relays the Yamaura Maru report.
subfiles.summary: The paraphrase dates the Curaçao call January 12, while the telegram says January 13.

subfiles.title: Ginyo Maru at Callao
subfiles.about: Reports the Ginyo Maru’s northbound call at Callao.
subfiles.summary: The ship arrived from Cerro Azul and left for Chancay, Manzanillo, and Los Angeles.

subfiles.title: Ginyo Maru report for Navy and Coast Guard
subfiles.about: Relays the Ginyo Maru’s Callao movements.
subfiles.summary: Repeats its January 12 arrival and departure.

subfiles.title: Onoe Maru departs Bombay
subfiles.about: Reports the Onoe Maru’s departure for Japan.
subfiles.summary: It sailed January 12 for Kobe via Singapore and Shanghai.

subfiles.title: Onoe Maru report for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Relays the Onoe Maru’s Bombay departure.
subfiles.summary: Repeats the route through Singapore and Shanghai to Kobe.

subfiles.title: Suspect cargo on Yamasuki Maru
subfiles.about: Responds to an inquiry about suspected cargo on the Yamasuki Maru.
subfiles.summary: Acheson found no cause to suspect the Buenos Aires cargo. Brazilian controls would block strategic exports to undesirable destinations, while officials investigated possible earlier sales.

subfiles.title: Manila Maru at Santos
subfiles.about: Reports the Manila Maru’s call at Santos.
subfiles.summary: It arrived from Kobe and sailed for Japan via Buenos Aires and the Strait of Magellan.

subfiles.title: Manila Maru report for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Relays the Manila Maru’s Santos movements.
subfiles.summary: The report was telephoned and teletyped to Navy recipients.

subfiles.title: Seia Maru at Buenos Aires
subfiles.about: Reports the Seia Maru’s arrival and departure.
subfiles.summary: It arrived January 8 and departed for Los Angeles on January 14.

subfiles.title: Seia Maru report for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Relays the Seia Maru’s Buenos Aires movements.
subfiles.summary: Repeats its arrival and Los Angeles destination.

subfiles.title: Four Japanese vessels at Singapore
subfiles.about: Reports Singapore calls by four Japanese merchant vessels.
subfiles.summary: Lists the Himolaya, Penang, Havana, and Matue Maru, with arrival points and onward destinations.

subfiles.title: Four Singapore vessel reports for Navy
subfiles.about: Relays the four Singapore vessel itineraries.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases movements of the Matue, Himolaya, Havana, and Penang Maru.

subfiles.title: Kiyakawa Maru at Callao
subfiles.about: Reports the Kiyakawa Maru’s Callao call.
subfiles.summary: It arrived from Valparaíso and sailed for Kobe.

subfiles.title: Kiyohawa Maru at Guayaquil
subfiles.about: Reports the vessel’s arrival from Balboa and onward sailing.
subfiles.summary: The ship sailed for Callao and southern ports.

subfiles.title: Japanese vessel movements near Australia
subfiles.about: Reports two Japanese vessels near Australia and New Caledonia.
subfiles.summary: The Yama-Giku arrived at Nouméa; the Kasima left Brisbane for Davao via Thursday Island.

subfiles.title: Australian vessel report for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Copies the report on the Yama-Giku and Kasima.
subfiles.summary: Repeats their arrival and departure information.

subfiles.title: Anyo Maru at Singapore
subfiles.about: Reports the Anyo Maru’s Singapore call.
subfiles.summary: It arrived from Colombo and sailed directly for Kanmon (Moji).

subfiles.title: Anyo Maru report for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Relays the Anyo Maru’s Singapore call.
subfiles.summary: Repeats its arrival from Colombo and direct sailing to Kanmon.

subfiles.title: Heiyo Maru at Valparaíso
subfiles.about: Reports the Heiyo Maru’s call and departure.
subfiles.summary: It arrived from Arica and sailed for Kobe via Manzanillo.

subfiles.title: Heiyo Maru report for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Relays the Heiyo Maru’s Valparaíso movements.
subfiles.summary: Records teleprinter and telephone transmission to Navy officials.

subfiles.title: Inquiry about Japanese ships in Netherlands East Indies
subfiles.about: Requests names of Japanese ships in Netherlands East Indies ports.
subfiles.summary: Sent at Lieutenant Van Blarcom’s request for the Navy Department.

subfiles.title: Sagami Maru at Buenaventura
subfiles.about: Reports the Sagami Maru’s call and dangerous-cargo flag.
subfiles.summary: The ship arrived via California and Central America, then departed for Peru and Chile.

subfiles.title: Sagami Maru report for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Relays the Sagami Maru’s Buenaventura report.
subfiles.summary: Notes its dangerous-cargo flag and southbound departure.

subfiles.title: Rakuyo Maru at Callao
subfiles.about: Reports the Rakuyo Maru’s Callao call.
subfiles.summary: It arrived from Valparaíso and sailed for Kobe.

subfiles.title: Hie Maru at Callao
subfiles.about: Reports the Hie Maru’s Callao arrival and planned ports.
subfiles.summary: It arrived from Antofagasta and was to sail through Peruvian, Panamanian, and Mexican ports to Los Angeles.

subfiles.title: Hie Maru report for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Relays the Hie Maru’s northbound itinerary.
subfiles.summary: Lists Huacho, Paita, Salinas, Balboa, Acapulco, Manzanillo, and Los Angeles.

subfiles.title: Kiyokawa Maru at Callao
subfiles.about: Reports the Kiyokawa Maru’s Callao call.
subfiles.summary: It arrived from Guayaquil and was leaving for Mollendo and Valparaíso.

subfiles.title: Kiyokawa Maru report for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Relays the Kiyokawa Maru’s Callao movements.
subfiles.summary: Repeats its arrival and onward ports.

subfiles.title: Kurama Maru and Montevideo Maru at Santos
subfiles.about: Forwards the Santos vice consul’s reports on two ships.
subfiles.summary: The Kurama Maru sailed toward Los Angeles; the Montevideo Maru sailed toward Montevideo and Buenos Aires.

subfiles.title: Santos vessel report for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Relays the two Santos vessel itineraries.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases the Kurama Maru and Montevideo Maru routes.

subfiles.title: Brisbane Maru and Montevideo Maru at Montevideo
subfiles.about: Reports two Japanese ships’ Montevideo calls and routes.
subfiles.summary: The Brisbane Maru headed toward Japan via Brazil and South Africa; the Montevideo Maru was bound for Yokohama via the Americas.

subfiles.title: Montevideo vessel report for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Relays the two Montevideo vessel itineraries.
subfiles.summary: Repeats the routes of the Montevideo Maru and Brisbane Maru.

subfiles.title: Hakone Maru at Singapore
subfiles.about: Reports the Hakone Maru’s Singapore call.
subfiles.summary: It arrived from Hong Kong January 16 and sailed for Bombay via Penang and Colombo January 17.

subfiles.title: Takaoka Maru and Sagami Maru at Callao
subfiles.about: Reports two Japanese vessels’ Callao calls.
subfiles.summary: The Takaoka Maru headed toward Los Angeles; the Sagami Maru headed toward Mollendo and Valparaíso.

subfiles.title: Ginyo Maru at Salinas
subfiles.about: Reports the Ginyo Maru’s brief Salinas call.
subfiles.summary: It sailed for Manzanillo; the local German colony reportedly showed interest in the ship.

subfiles.title: Ginyo Maru report for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Relays the Ginyo Maru’s Salinas call.
subfiles.summary: Repeats its departure and reported German-colony interest.

subfiles.title: Hei Maru at Salinas
subfiles.about: Reports the Hei Maru’s Salinas call.
subfiles.summary: It landed eighteen passengers, reportedly refugees, and sailed for Balboa.

subfiles.title: Hei Maru report for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Relays the Hei Maru’s Salinas report.
subfiles.summary: Repeats the landing of eighteen passengers and departure for Balboa.

subfiles.title: Australian reporting of Japanese vessel movements
subfiles.from: American Consulate General, Sydney; Albert M. Doyle
subfiles.about: Explains Australian reporting procedures and limits on obtaining Japanese ships’ itineraries.
subfiles.summary: Australian defence rules prevented ships’ agents from giving American consuls complete prior and future port information for bills of health. Doyle describes how consulates would coordinate reports, lists regular Japanese shipping services and routes through Australia, and expects few reports concerning U.S. or Canal Zone ports. Philippine-bound sailings would still be reported.

subfiles.title: Instruction to seek Australian vessel information
subfiles.about: Asks the consul to seek vessel information from Australian defence authorities or publications.
subfiles.summary: The Navy wanted movements reported for foreign as well as U.S. destinations.

subfiles.title: Sydney despatch forwarded to Navy
subfiles.about: Forwards Doyle’s Sydney despatch on Japanese-vessel reporting.
subfiles.summary: Encloses despatch 918 and cites related State–Navy correspondence.

subfiles.title: Four Japanese vessels at Singapore
subfiles.about: Reports movements of four Japanese vessels through Singapore.
subfiles.summary: Lists the Sumatra, Hague, Borneo, and Onoe Maru with arrival ports and onward routes.

subfiles.title: Four Singapore vessel reports for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Relays the four Singapore vessel itineraries.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases routes of the Onoe, Borneo, Sumatra, and Hague Maru.

subfiles.title: Nana at La Guaira
subfiles.about: Reports the Nana’s La Guaira call.
subfiles.summary: It arrived from Panama and sailed for Rio de Janeiro and other eastern South American ports.

subfiles.title: Nana report for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Relays the Nana’s La Guaira movements.
subfiles.summary: Repeats its same-day arrival and departure.

subfiles.title: Seia Maru and Africa Maru depart Santos
subfiles.about: Forwards the Santos vice consul’s report on two departures.
subfiles.summary: The visible text gives the Seia Maru’s route to Los Angeles; the Africa Maru entry is cut off.

subfiles.title: Santos departures report for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Relays the Seia Maru and Africa Maru departures.
subfiles.summary: The Seia Maru headed to Los Angeles via Brazil, Venezuela, and Panama; the Africa Maru headed to Yokohama via South Africa.

subfiles.title: Catch sheet
subfiles.about: Marks a file catch or cross-reference.
subfiles.summary: Only a catch notation and date are legible.

subfiles.title: Tenerife inquiry on foreign-flag tankers
subfiles.about: Asks whether Panamanian-flag tankers should be reported.
subfiles.summary: Only occasional Portuguese and Standard Oil tank steamers called at Tenerife.

subfiles.title: Tenerife inquiry forwarded to Navy
subfiles.about: Asks whether the Navy wants Tenerife’s foreign-flag vessel movements reported.
subfiles.summary: Encloses Scott’s January 22 telegram.

subfiles.title: Genoa Maru and Delagoa Maru at Singapore
subfiles.about: Reports two Japanese vessels’ Singapore calls.
subfiles.summary: The Genoa Maru sailed toward Calcutta; the Delagoa Maru sailed toward Japan via Hong Kong and Shanghai. The paraphrase clarifies garbled dates.

subfiles.title: Genoa and Delagoa Maru report for OPNAV
subfiles.about: Relays the two Singapore vessel itineraries.
subfiles.summary: Both arrived January 21 and departed January 22 on their respective routes.

subfiles.title: Azuma Maru at Barranquilla
subfiles.about: Reports the Azuma Maru’s arrival and departure.
subfiles.summary: It arrived from Panama and departed for New York, Boston, and Philadelphia.
